inj.note: Sampson was out-carried 11 to one by Quinshon Judkins, but the former has carved out a role as the preferred pass-catching back for Cleveland since returning from injured reserve in Week 7. Over the last two games, Sampson has turned 11 targets into nine catches for 94 yards while adding seven carries for 52 yards. Sampson will have some PPR fantasy appeal during weeks when the Browns are projected to trail on the scoreboard.

news.h: Browns RBs Quinshon Judkins, Dylan Sampson expected to play
news.d: The Browns' top two running backs, Quinshon Judkins and Dylan Sampson, are expected to play against the Titans after being sidelined with injuries.
